up: Retrieve the molecule chembl_id, preferred name, canonical SMILES, standard_type, standard_value, and standard_units for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614174. Filter for exact activity values only by requiring activities.standard_relation = '=' and activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL. Join assays, activities, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures on assay_id and molregno. Do not apply any additional filters or row limits.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, act.standard_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_units FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614174' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL
